key_insight: The paper shows that agentic AI can help build machine-checked Lean formalizations of Shor’s algorithm and its resource estimates, extending formal quantum cryptanalysis to RSA-2048 and P-256.
engineering_relevance: It demonstrates a workflow for verifying quantum attack logic and cost estimates in a theorem prover, which is useful for high-assurance cryptography and future quantum-algorithm engineering.
method: Agentic systems search sources, generate Lean code, and repair proofs.
Human reviewers validate scientific claims while Lean checks the formal proofs.
Formalizes order finding, reversible modular arithmetic, and elliptic-curve arithmetic for RSA-2048 and P-256 analyses.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports machine-checked formalizations of the algorithm family plus resource estimates for RSA-2048 and P-256, grounded in prior results from Quantum 5 and ASIACRYPT 2017.
watch_item: The work relies on agent-generated proofs and paper-based resource estimates, so practical scalability and the fidelity of formal cost models still need careful validation.
paper_title: Building Shor's Algorithm in Lean: An Agentic Formalization of Quantum Attacks on RSA-2048 and P-256
